patch.value: api.hooks.onWrite gated by decidePushOnWrite (pure): acts only when PM_JIRA_PUSH_ON_WRITE truthy AND project-scoped create/update (ignores :history, delete, non-project). No-op without creds; hook runtime swallows throws. Verified active (hook_counts write:1) and that pm create still exits 0 with hook enabled and no creds. Live upstream PUT intentionally left to explicit 'export --push' so a stray write never spams Jira.
